headline: Petitions for a livery company and driver on Linwood Street, and lodging house renewals on Washington, Charles, and Cedar Streets.
summary: The committee will review a new livery company and driver petition for 64 Linwood Street, and renewal petitions for lodging houses at 115 Washington Street, 22 Charles Street, and 116-118 Cedar Street.
